eps.d: Spoof documentary series looking at Middle England through the eyes of film-maker Roy Mallard. A managing director talks about the life of his company.
Roy visits an estate agent's in Lewes, Sussex.
A routine day on duty with PC David Knight in Northampton turns into a tense rooftop drama when an insurance company employee threatens to commit suicide.
Roy visits Nicola and Graham Broadbent, who run a small firm of solicitors in Cheshire. The firm specialises in matrimonial cases, but it transpires that they have a matrimonial case of their own.
Roy meets a freelance photographer who is based in Winchester.
Roy visits a comprehensive school in Kent.
A vicar from Thame in Oxfordshire discusses tough theological issues.
Jenny Gardner offers an insight into being a young mother.
Roy spends a day with journalists at the Long Eaton Gazette and marvels as a newspaper is created.
Roy Mallard follows actor Rob Harker through the world of auditions and voiceovers as he awaits his big break.
Roy Mallard spends a day at the Swindon branch of the FirstNat Standard Bank, where he tries to understand the appraisal system.
Roy prepares to fly with a major UK airline.
